  <p>
    I am a <strong>PhD Student in Computer Science</strong> at the <strong>University of Milano-Bicocca</strong>, where my doctoral research explores <strong>Virtual Reality in mental healthcare</strong> at the intersection of <strong>artificial intelligence</strong>, <strong>physiological and environmental sensors</strong>, <strong>Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)</strong>, and <strong>serious games</strong>.
  </p>
  <p>
    Alongside my PhD, I have over four years of experience as a <strong>Software Developer and Research Technologist</strong> in the <strong>Digital Health Research</strong> unit at <strong>Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK)</strong> in Trento, Italy. Working closely with clinicians and psychologists, I design and build interactive VR/XR applications, sensor-driven pipelines, and AI-assisted tools for applied healthcare research.
  </p>

## Recent News

- **2026** — Enrolled in the **PhD programme in Computer Science** at the **University of Milano-Bicocca**, focusing on VR, AI, sensors, HCI, and serious games for mental healthcare.
- **March 2026** — Graduated with a **Master's degree in Computer Science** (*110/110 cum laude*) from the **University of Trento**, defending the thesis *"Towards shape-aware heart rate estimation"*.
- **December 2025** — Co-authored the study protocol for **iEMBRACE** in *BMJ Open* ([10.1136/bmjopen-2024-098051](https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjopen-2024-098051)), investigating customised VR environments for patients with cognitive decline.
